title: Ramps and rolling
examples: Teacher, does the ramp need to be straight?
If I use a bumpy ramp, will it roll faster?
What makes something roll faster down a slope?

explain.say: Today we are learning about ramps and how things roll.
A steep slope means the ramp goes up very fast.
A gentle slope means the ramp goes up very slowly.
Things roll faster when the slope is steep.
A flat surface means there is no real slope at all.
In real life, a slide at the playground is a ramp.

faq.q: Does the steepness of the ramp change how fast it rolls?
faq.a: Yes, a steeper ramp makes things roll much faster. A gentler ramp makes things roll slower.
asks: Does the angle matter for speed?
Will a steep ramp make it go fast?

faq.q: Is a flat surface as fast as a steep ramp?
faq.a: No, a flat surface means nothing rolls easily. You need a slope for rolling motion.
asks: Can it roll on the ground?
Does it need a slope to move?

faq.q: What is the difference between steep and gentle?
faq.a: Steep means it goes up quickly, like a big hill. Gentle means it goes up slowly, like a small hill.
asks: What does 'gentle' mean for a ramp?

faq.q: Does the weight of the object matter?
faq.a: The steepness is the most important thing we learned today. Weight can make it faster, but the slope is key.
asks: Does a big ball roll faster than a small ball?
Is weight more important than the slope?

faq.q: Can I make my own ramp to test this?
faq.a: Yes, you can use books or blocks to make different slopes. Test what happens when you change the angle.
asks: How can I test this at home?

facts: Gravity pulls objects downwards, making them roll.
A steeper slope causes objects to accelerate faster.
A flat surface has a zero degree slope.
The speed of rolling depends on the slope's angle.

quiz.say: If you roll a toy car down a ramp, what happens if you make the ramp very steep?

options.show: It will not roll at all.
options.say: It will not roll at all.

options.show: It will roll only if it is bumpy.
options.say: It will roll only if it is bumpy.

quiz.why: The steeper the slope, the stronger gravity pulls the car, making it roll faster.

wrong.1: This is wrong because a steep slope increases the pull of gravity.
wrong.2: This is wrong because gravity still pulls the car down the slope.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the main factor is the steepness, not the bumps.

quiz.say: Rolling a ball on a gentle slope compared to a steep slope:

options.show: It rolls faster on the gentle slope.
options.say: It rolls faster on the gentle slope.

options.show: It rolls at the same speed.
options.say: It rolls at the same speed.

options.show: It only rolls if the slope is flat.
options.say: It only rolls if the slope is flat.

options.show: It rolls slower on the gentle slope.
options.say: It rolls slower on the gentle slope.

quiz.why: Gentle slopes mean the angle is small, so the force pulling the ball down is less.

wrong.0: This is wrong because gentle slopes mean a smaller angle and less force.
wrong.1: This is wrong because the angle of the slope directly affects the speed.
wrong.2: This is wrong because rolling needs a downward slope, not a flat surface.

quiz.say: If a ramp is perfectly flat, what is the slope angle?
quiz.why: A flat surface has no change in height, so its angle is zero degrees.

wrong.0: This is wrong because 45 degrees is a diagonal slope, not flat.
wrong.1: This is wrong because 180 degrees means going backward along a line.
wrong.3: This is wrong because 90 degrees is straight up, not flat.
